onboarding.title: Onboarding Program
onboarding.subtitle: Helping new members integrate into the Ynuka Labs ecosystem.
onboarding.whatDesc: The Onboarding Program is a structured welcome path that helps new members understand the ecosystem, tools, and opportunities within Ynuka Labs.
onboarding.impactDesc: This program improves member retention, speeds up practical learning, and increases the number of participants who move into real project execution.
onboarding.donateDesc: Your contributions help us fund intro sessions, learning resources, and onboarding support for new participants.
onboarding.storyText: Since 2023, Ynuka Labs identified a strong need for Web3 education, especially around the Cardano blockchain. This led us to launch this program, through which at the end of each month we mobilize our limited resources and recruit young entrepreneurs, students, and technology enthusiasts to provide a one-week training on topics such as Web3, distributed ledger technology, blockchain, Cardano wallets, and other practical foundations for their journey.

onboarding.donateJustification: Your support helps keep this program alive: venue access, internet connectivity, learning materials, learner support, and post-training follow-up. Every contribution, even small, strengthens real impact for local youth.
